user.title: Minol Energy – Sign In
user.description:
**Step 1:** Open the link below in your browser and sign in with your Minol account:

[Open Minol login]({auth_url})

**Step 2:** After signing in, the browser tries to open an address starting with `msalb751cea9-…://auth/?code=…` and fails – that is expected. Copy that address:
- **Chrome / Edge:** press F12, open the *Console* tab and copy the line `Failed to launch 'msal…://auth/?code=…'`.
- **Firefox:** copy the address from the error page or the address bar.

**Step 3:** Paste it below – the whole console line, the address or just the code all work. The code expires after a few minutes.

data.redirect_url: Redirect URL or code (from the browser console / address bar)
